general.rescoreNotice: Saving these changes rescores every participation in the background, and re-rates the contest if it has ratings.

rate.notEnded: Rating is available once the contest has ended.
rate.frozen: The ranking is still frozen. Unfreeze it below to rate the contest.

problemOps.title: Rejudge or rescore one problem
problemOps.description: Rejudge resets this problem's submissions in this contest and judges them again. Rescore recomputes their points and the affected participations without judging, which is faster than rescoring the whole contest.
problemOps.noProblems: Save at least one problem first.
problemOps.willRejudge: {count} submissions of {code} in this contest will be judged again. Results change as they finish.

freezeState.unsupported: This contest format never freezes its ranking.
freezeState.frozen: Frozen since {time}. It stays frozen after the end until you unfreeze it.

lockState.off: Not locked. Submissions can be rejudged.
lockState.locked: Locked since {time}. Submissions are not rejudged unless forced.

unfreeze.title: Unfreeze the ranking?
unfreeze.body: Everyone will see the live ranking. The contest is rescored, and re-rated if it has ratings.

refreeze.title: Freeze the ranking?
refreeze.body: The public ranking stops updating for the last minutes of the contest. The contest is rescored.

lock.title: Lock submissions now?
lock.body: Existing live submissions are locked too and are not rejudged unless forced.

unlock.title: Remove the lock?
unlock.body: Live submissions can be rejudged again.

delete.title: Delete contest
delete.description: Deletes a hidden contest that has no ratings. Its participations, announcements, ranking link, ghosts, replay and official ranking are deleted. Its submissions are kept outside any contest. This cannot be undone.
delete.visible: Hide the contest on the General tab before deleting it.
delete.confirmBody: Everything that belongs to this contest is deleted. This cannot be undone.

participants.startHint: Leave empty for now while the contest runs, else the contest start (live) or now (virtual).
participants.moveStartBody: A timed participant gets a new window from this time. The participation is recomputed.
participants.deleteBody: Only a participation without submissions can be deleted. To remove someone with submissions, take them off the board instead.

announcements.editNote: Edits keep the original post time and are not sent again. Use resend to notify.
